svg.title: MarkeTech infrastructure: from a commit to production
svg.desc: Panel A: work is committed on develop, then merged into main with git merge --no-ff. The workflow Test and publish images runs on a push to develop or main that changes backend/, frontend/ or a workflow file (documentation and Markdown files excluded). Panel B: the job test sets up Python 3.13 and runs python manage.py test with config.settings.dev and a test-only DJANGO_SECRET_KEY; the job build needs test and runs twice, for backend and frontend: it logs in to ghcr.io with GITHUB_TOKEN, computes the tags sha-<7 chars> and latest (default branch only), builds the image and pushes it only from main. Each of the five actions used is pinned to a full commit SHA, with its version in a comment. Panel C: the public images ghcr.io/danielgarcia85/marketech-backend and marketech-frontend; latest is the most recent image of main, and a sha- tag exists for each commit of main that ran the workflow. Panel D: the production server, outside this repository, pulls new backend and frontend images every two minutes and recreates the changed containers; it never builds; IMAGE_TAG in its .env can pin one version for a rollback; its docker-compose.yml is not pulled but copied by hand when it changes on main. A new backend container runs entrypoint.sh (migrations, then Daphne), detailed in backend-request-flow.svg, panel A.
svg.text: MarkeTech infrastructure: from a commit to production
A push on develop that changes the code runs the tests and builds the images; on main it also publishes them, and production then runs them. Follow the numbers 1 to 7.
Real files of the repository: .github/workflows/publish-images.yml, docker-compose.yml, .env.example, backend/entrypoint.sh.
GitHub-hosted runners, created for the run

svg.text: --no-ff always creates a merge commit on main, even when a fast-forward was possible:
each merge stays visible in the history, and its push starts the run that publishes, when the merge changes the code.

svg.text: pushed here by job build, panel B (main only)

g.text: From develop, nothing reaches the registry
The two images are built (proof that they still build), then discarded: push is false outside main. "latest" is only given on the
default branch, main, so it always designates the most recent image of main.

text.font-family: Consolas, 'SF Mono', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
Consolas, 'SF Mono', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: The server keeps its own copy, copied
by hand when it changes on main.
Migrations run before Daphne, with set -e: if one fails, the backend does not start, so it never serves a half-prepared application.
